items.summary: Accident and Health Insurance stocks like AFL, UNM, GL, TRUP and EIG are set to gain from rising underwriting exposure and accelerated digitalization. However, pricing pressure is a concern given rising medical costs and inflation.

items.title: GL Q3 deep dive: Medicare claims and group health volatility weigh on margins
items.summary: Insurance holding company Globe Life (NYSE:GL) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with sales up 6% year on year to $1.61 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $4.84 per share was 1.1% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: Globe Life Sinks 8% as Piper Sandler Downgrade Says It’s No Longer a “Predictable Safe Haven”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGlobe Life shares fell 8% after Piper Sandler downgraded the stock to Neutral from Overweight and cut its price target to $165 from $200. Piper Sandler says Globe Life is no longer a predictable safe haven, pointing to bigger medical claims, irregular Medicare supplement claims and softer 2027 guidance.
